panels.title: Tool-Aufrufe (nach Variante)
panels.description: Anzahl der Telemetrie-Events pro Variant (exe / plugin) im Zeitverlauf.

targets.expr: sum by (variant) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"}[$__auto]))

panels.title: Aufgetretene Fehler
panels.description: Summe des JSON-Felds 'errors' aus den Telemetrie-Events; bündelt alle Variants/OS gemäß Filter.

targets.expr: sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap errors [$__auto])

panels.title: Gesamtaufrufe (Range)
panels.description: Anzahl aller eingegangenen Telemetrie-Events im aktuellen Zeitraum.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"}[$__auto]))

panels.title: Eindeutige Installationen
panels.description: Anzahl unterschiedlicher anonymousId-Werte (machineKey-Label nach JSON-Parse) im Zeitraum.

targets.expr: count(sum by (machineKey) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"} | json | machineKey != "" [$__auto])))

panels.title: Erfolgsquote
panels.description: Anteil der Läufe mit outcome=success an der Gesamtzahl im Zeitraum.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", outcome="success", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"}[$__auto])) / sum(count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"}[$__auto])) * 100

panels.title: Fehlerquote (Errors / Run)
panels.description: Σ errors geteilt durch Σ runs × 100. Zeigt durchschnittliche Fehler pro Lauf in %.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap errors [$__auto])) / sum(count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"}[$__auto])) * 100

panels.title: Σ entfernte Duplikate
panels.description: Summe aller in Telemetrie-Events gemeldeten typesRemoved-Werte im Zeitraum.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap typesRemoved [$__auto]))

panels.title: Σ Cecil-Rewrites
panels.description: Wie oft Mono.Cecil eine DLL nach dnlib-Änderungen neu geschrieben hat (Summe über alle Läufe).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap rewritesPerformed [$__auto]))

panels.title: Outcome-Verteilung
panels.description: Donut nach success/partial/failed (Loki-Stream-Label outcome).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

panels.title: OS-Verteilung
panels.description: Donut über Loki-Stream-Label os (Win32NT / Unix).

targets.expr: sum by (os) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Variant-Verteilung
panels.description: Donut über Loki-Stream-Label variant (exe / plugin).

targets.expr: sum by (variant) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", os=~"$os", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"}[$__range]))

panels.title: .NET-Runtime-Versionen
panels.description: Aufrufe gruppiert nach dem JSON-Feld runtimeVersion (z.B. .NET 6.0.x, .NET 10.0.x).

targets.expr: sum by (runtimeVersion) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | runtimeVersion != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Prozessor-Architekturen
panels.description: Verteilung des JSON-Felds processArch (X64, ARM64, …).

targets.expr: sum by (processArch) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | processArch != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Locales / Sprachen
panels.description: Aufrufe gruppiert nach JSON-Feld cultureName (z.B. de-DE, en-US).

targets.expr: sum by (cultureName) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | cultureName != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Detaillierte OS-Versionen
panels.description: Tabelle mit os + osDescription (Microsoft Windows 10.0.26200, Linux 6.x …).

targets.expr: sum by (os, osDescription) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", version=~"$version"} | json | osDescription != "" [$__auto]))

panels.title: CPU-Kern-Verteilung
panels.description: Histogramm-Annäherung: Anzahl Aufrufe pro berichtetem cpuCount-Wert.

targets.expr: sum by (cpuCount) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | cpuCount != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Game-Verteilung
panels.description: Donut über das vom Plugin gemeldete gameName-Feld (z.B. 'Data Center').

targets.expr: sum by (gameName) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant="plugin"} | json | gameName != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Spielversionen
panels.description: Aufrufe nach gameName + gameVersion (zeigt z.B. Data Center 1.0.49.1 vs 1.0.50.3).

targets.expr: sum by (gameName, gameVersion) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant="plugin"} | json | gameVersion != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Unity-Engine-Versionen
panels.description: Aufrufe nach unityVersion (UnityEngine-Version, vom Plugin via UnityInformationHandler).

targets.expr: sum by (unityVersion) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant="plugin"} | json | unityVersion != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: MelonLoader-Versionen
panels.description: Aufrufe nach melonLoaderVersion (vom Plugin via MelonLoader.BuildInfo.Version).

targets.expr: sum by (melonLoaderVersion) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant="plugin"} | json | melonLoaderVersion != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Aufrufe nach Tool-Version
panels.description: Verteilung der Aufrufe pro Fixer-Release-Version (Loki-Stream-Label version).

targets.expr: sum by (version) (count_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Dauer p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
panels.description: Quantile der durationMs-Verteilung über die Zeit.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap durationMs [$__auto])
quantile_over_time(0.95, {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap durationMs [$__auto])
quantile_over_time(0.99, {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap durationMs [$__auto])

panels.title: Ø Dauer pro Variante (ms)
panels.description: Durchschnitt von durationMs pro Variant-Label im Zeitverlauf.

targets.expr: avg by (variant) (avg_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))

panels.title: Assemblies: scanned vs modified vs skipped
panels.description: Drei Zeitreihen aus den JSON-Feldern assembliesScanned / assembliesModified / assembliesSkipped.

targets.expr: sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap assembliesScanned  [$__auto])
sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap assembliesModified [$__auto])
sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap assembliesSkipped  [$__auto])

panels.title: Entfernte Duplikate über Zeit
panels.description: Bar-Timeseries auf typesRemoved. Spitzen markieren neu eingeführte Cpp2IL-Probleme.

targets.expr: sum_over_time({app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | unwrap typesRemoved [$__auto])

panels.title: Top-DLLs mit Duplikaten
panels.description: Jeder Eintrag zeigt einen Lauf, in dem mindestens ein Duplikat entfernt wurde, plus die Per-DLL-Liste aus dem assemblies-Array.

targets.expr: {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | typesRemoved > 0 | line_format "[{{.gameName}} {{.gameVersion}} / {{.unityVersion}}] removed={{.typesRemoved}} → {{.assemblies}}"

panels.title: Letzte Läufe mit Fehlern
panels.description: Failed/partial Runs (outcome != success) als formatierte Log-Lines.

targets.expr: {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", outcome=~"failed|partial", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version"} | json | line_format "[{{.variant}} {{.version}} {{.os}} / {{.gameName}} {{.gameVersion}}] scanned={{.assembliesScanned}} modified={{.assembliesModified}} removed={{.typesRemoved}} errors={{.errors}} duration={{.durationMs}}ms"

panels.title: Run-Detailtabelle (letzte 50)
panels.description: Top 50 jüngsten Telemetrie-Events nach JSON-Parse — alle Felder als Tabellenspalten.

targets.expr: {app="il2cpp-assembly-fixer", variant=~"$variant", os=~"$os", version=~"$version", outcome=~"$outcome"} | json
